site.title: Para
site.tagline: A general-purpose backend for the cloud
site.description: Para is an open-source, stateless and schemaless backend with a REST API over any database, search index and cache. Self-host it anywhere, or let Para Cloud run it for you.

hero.headline: A general-purpose backend for the cloud
hero.subtext: Para is an open-source, stateless and schemaless backend with a REST API over any database, search index and cache.

features.headline: Three layers. No schema. No lock-in.
features.subtext: Para is built from swappable layers, not a monolith. Every capability below ships in the core or as a plugin.

items.title: Schemaless objects
items.body: Plain JSON in, plain JSON out. No migrations, no ORM ceremony. Works on key-value stores and traditional databases alike.

items.title: Three layers
items.body: Every object is persisted, indexed and cached by default. Swap the database, the search engine and the cache independently.

items.title: Stateless scaling
items.body: No sticky sessions, no node-local state. Scaling out is a load balancer decision, not a re-architecture.

items.title: Multitenant apps
items.body: Each App gets its own table, index and cache. Child apps inherit the root app keys and settings.

items.title: Pluggable modules
items.body: SQL, MongoDB, Cassandra or DynamoDB. Lucene or Elasticsearch. Caffeine or Hazelcast. Choose per deployment, not per product.

items.title: Auth built in
items.body: JWT, passwordless logins, LDAP, SAML and social login for all the major identity providers.

items.title: Webhooks
items.body: Signed webhook payloads on object events. Wire Para into anything that speaks HTTP.

items.title: MCP server
items.body: A built-in MCP server lets AI agents read and write your data directly, with the same permissions as any client.

comparison.headline: Why not Supabase?
comparison.subtext: Para is a general-purpose backend, not a hosted database with extras. Different trade-offs, fewer lock-ins.
comparison.jab: // Supabase is a fine Postgres. It is still one database.

cloud.headline: Prefer not to run it yourself?
cloud.subtext: Para Cloud is the managed version of Para — hosted, patched and backed up by the makers.
points: Managed hosting by the makers of Para

cta.headline: Self-host in minutes
cta.subtext: One JAR, one config file, any database. The quickstart has you persisting objects before your coffee cools.

footer.credit: Built by Erudika, also makers of Scoold.
